Household aisle inspiration

Two real living rooms, broken down piece by piece — for ideas on freshening up with what's in the household aisle.

Look 01 — Quiet neutral

Natural textures, kept low-contrast

Cream sofa, honey wood, sandy cushions — almost everything sits in the same warm range, so the darker or patterned pieces stand out without shouting. A woven pendant light anchors the room; everything else stays quiet around it.

  • Cushions — mixed textures, layered rather than matched
  • Greenery — one tall leafy plant plus dried grasses in simple vases
  • Small tablescape — leaned frames, a candle, a low vase
Look 02 — Modern eclectic

Black, white and brass, used with intent

Black shelving and gold frames give the wall structure, a striped rug does the work a patterned cushion does elsewhere, and one warm metallic — repeated three or four times — ties the room together.

  • Gallery wall — a cluster of matching frames around one bigger piece
  • Rug layering — a patterned rug over a plain base rug
  • Repeated accent — the same metal or colour shown up several times

Looking for cushions, candles, storage baskets, or small plant pots to try any of this at home? That's what's on the household shelf — ask in-store or call 024 454 7744.

About DayBreak

DayBreak is a general store on the Eastern By-Pass, next to Custom's Office — the kind of shop you stop at without planning to, and leave with everything you actually needed.

The shelves are kept simple on purpose: groceries, household basics, drinks, and the small things that run out at the worst possible time. No long aisles to search through, just what a household needs, close by.

Alongside everyday shopping, the store also handles mobile money top-ups and transfers, so a quick errand often covers more than one thing at once. It's rated 4.3 by local shoppers, with reviews calling it "fantastic" and a dependable regular stop.

Common questions

Do you accept mobile money?

Mobile money top-ups and transfers are one of the store's regular services. Call ahead if you're relying on a specific network.

What time do you open?

The store's listing confirms a 7:00 am opening on Tuesdays. Hours for other days weren't listed — call 024 454 7744 to confirm before visiting.

Do you deliver?

Delivery isn't listed as a service. The most reliable way to check is to call the store directly.

Where exactly is the store?

It's on the Eastern By-Pass in Kumasi, right next to Custom's Office. Use the "Get directions" button above to open it in Google Maps.

Can I call ahead to check stock?

Yes — for anything specific, a quick call to 024 454 7744 will save a wasted trip.

What payment methods do you take?

Cash and mobile money are both handled at the till. If you're relying on a card, call ahead to confirm before you make the trip.
